answer: A concrete defense is staged escrow with ripple detection. Rewards land first in a time-locked vault, released only after the comet beacon rolls several epochs; during that window each payout is cross-checked against payout graphs, and any ripple, clusters of accounts whose balances move in lockstep, freezes the whole cluster for audit. Frozen funds evaporate at escrow expiry. A sybil farm must keep its loot locked and visible for many epochs, tying up its own stake while audits run, while an honest agent waits out the vault and withdraws once.
